title: Experienced Advocates
description: Nearly three decades of courtroom practice across twelve disciplines. The partner who advises you at the first consultation is the advocate who argues your matter — briefs are not quietly reassigned.

title: Client Confidentiality
description: Every instruction is privileged from the first conversation, before any engagement is agreed. Enquiries are stored securely, and no client name or matter detail is published without express written consent.

title: Transparent Consultation
description: Fees are quoted before work begins, in a written engagement letter. Court fees, stamp duty and government charges are always itemised separately from professional fees, so nothing is buried.

title: Quick Response
description: Website enquiries are acknowledged immediately and answered within one working day. For arrest, detention or search matters, the office line reaches our criminal practice partner outside working hours.

title: Personalised Legal Advice
description: Documentation is drafted for your facts rather than adapted from a template, and strategy is set around the outcome you actually need — which is not always the one a court can order.

title: Ethical Practice
description: We give you the honest merits of your case, including when litigation is the wrong route or the claim is weak. Where a matter falls outside our competence, we refer it on rather than accept the brief.
